words.en: Periods of time spent away from work or school, typically including public holidays and the weekend.

words.ex: He visited his grandma last September.
words.ex_cn: 他去年九月去看了他的奶奶。
words.en: Last September refers to the month of September in the previous year.

words.ex: The late 17th century saw the rise of modern science.
words.ex_cn: 17世纪末见证了现代科学的兴起。
words.en: The period from approximately 1650 to 1699.

words.ex: The clock struck midnight.
words.ex_cn: 钟敲响了午夜。
words.en: Midnight is twelve o'clock in the middle of the night.

words.tr: n. 午夜到凌晨三点三十分
words.ex: The security guard works from midnight to 3.30.
words.ex_cn: 保安的工作时间是午夜到凌晨三点三十分。

words.ex: He will return next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月回来。
words.en: A month is one of the twelve periods of time that a year is divided into, for example January or February.

words.ex: I drink coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早晨喝咖啡。
words.en: The morning is the part of each day between the time that people usually wake up and the time they start work or school, or the part of the day before noon.

words.ex: The stars are bright at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚星星很亮。
words.en: The period of darkness in each twenty-four hours; the time from sunset to sunrise.

words.ex: Many people travel during national holidays.
words.ex_cn: 很多人在国庆假期旅行。
words.en: National holidays are public holidays that are recognized and celebrated across a country, often marking significant historical, cultural, or religious events.

words.ex: We celebrate new year with fireworks.
words.ex_cn: 我们用烟花庆祝新年。
words.en: The period at the beginning of the year, especially the first few days or weeks, often celebrated as a time of new beginnings.

words.ex: We will meet next Tuesday.
words.ex_cn: 我们下周二见面。
words.en: The Tuesday immediately following the current one.

words.ex: She completed a 675-hour training program.
words.ex_cn: 她完成了一个675小时的培训项目。
words.en: An hour is a period of sixty minutes.

words.ex: He waits for one hour every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上等一小时。
words.en: A period of 60 minutes.

words.ex: We go to the park on Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在星期六去公园。
words.en: Saturday is the day of the week that comes after Friday and before Sunday.

words.tr: n. 第二个星期日（常用于指特定节日或活动日期，如母亲节在某些国家定于第二个星期日）
words.ex: Mother's Day is on the second Sundays in May.
words.ex_cn: 母亲节在五月的第二个星期日。
words.en: A recurring event that takes place on the second Sunday of each month.

words.ex: We go to the park on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在星期天去公园。
words.en: Sunday is the day of the week following Saturday and preceding Monday.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Thursday.
words.ex_cn: 我星期四有一个会议。
words.en: Thursday is the day of the week between Wednesday and Friday.

words.tr: n. 星期二至星期六（指从星期二到星期六的时段）
words.ex: The store is open from Tuesday to Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 这家店从星期二到星期六营业。

words.ex: I have a meeting on Wednesday.
words.ex_cn: 我在星期三有一个会议。
words.en: Wednesday is the day of the week that comes after Tuesday and before Thursday.

words.tr: phrase. 整个星期；完整的一周
words.ex: He stayed at home for the whole week.
words.ex_cn: 他整个星期都待在家里。
words.en: The entire period of seven days from Monday to Sunday.

words.ex: I have class on Thursday morning.
words.ex_cn: 我在星期四早上有课。
words.en: The morning of the day between Wednesday and Friday.

words.ex: I will visit you this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我这周末去看你。
words.en: The weekend is Saturday and Sunday, the two days in the week when many people do not work.

words.ex: The dinosaur lived in a long period ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙生活在很久以前的一个时期。
words.en: A period is a length of time in which something happens, or a stretch of time with a particular quality or characteristic.

words.ex: The number 75 appears on the whiteboard.
words.ex_cn: 数字75出现在白板上。

words.ex: He ran 7 miles every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑七英里。
words.en: A unit of linear measure equal to 1,760 yards (approximately 1.609 kilometers).

words.ex: 6 is just a number with no meaning here.
words.ex_cn: 6在这里只是一个没有意义的数字。

words.tr: phrase. 0.1 厘米（长度单位，等于一毫米）
words.ex: The wire is 0.1 cm thick.
words.ex_cn: 这根电线厚0.1厘米。
words.en: A measurement equal to one-tenth of a centimetre.

words.ex: 144 is just a number with no special meaning.
words.ex_cn: 144只是一个没有特殊意义的数字。

words.ex: No example sentences
words.ex_cn: 没有例句

words.ex: The number 650 appears on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 数字650出现在屏幕上。

words.ex: The answer to everything is 42.
words.ex_cn: 一切的答案是42。

words.ex: She is 140cm tall.
words.ex_cn: 她身高140厘米。
words.en: A measurement of 140 centimeters in length or height.

words.ex: 39000 is just a number with no special meaning.
words.ex_cn: 39000只是一个没有特殊意义的数字。

words.ex: The temperature is 65 degrees today.
words.ex_cn: 今天气温是65度。

words.ex: The book costs 985 yuan.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的价格是985元。

words.ex: 15 is just a number with no special meaning.
words.ex_cn: 15只是一个没有特殊意义的数字。

words.ex: No example sentences
words.ex_cn: 没有例句

words.ex: 85 is just a number with no meaning here.
words.ex_cn: 85在这里只是一个没有意义的数字。

words.ex: 23 is just a number with no meaning.
words.ex_cn: 23只是一个没有意义的数字。

words.tr: phrase. 45便士（英国货币单位，1英镑=100便士）
words.ex: The apple costs 45 pence.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果售价45便士。
words.en: A monetary amount of forty-five British pence.

words.ex: There are over 200 students in the hall.
words.ex_cn: 大厅里有200多名学生。
words.en: More than two hundred in number or quantity.

words.ex: 575 is just a number with no meaning.
words.ex_cn: 575只是一个没有意义的数字。

words.ex: 89 is just a number with no meaning.
words.ex_cn: 89只是一个没有意义的数字。

words.tr: n. 住房供给； v. 收容；“house”的现在分词；
words.ex: The city needs more housing for low-income families.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要为低收入家庭提供更多的住房供给。
words.en: Housing refers to buildings or other shelters in which people live; a place to live.

words.ex: The garage door opens automatically when you drive close to it.
words.ex_cn: 当你开车靠近时，车库门会自动打开。
words.en: A garage door is a large door on a garage that opens either manually or by an electric motor.

words.ex: He drinks coffee on the balcony every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在阳台上喝咖啡。
words.en: A balcony is a platform on the outside of a building, enclosed by walls or balustrades, supported by columns or console brackets. The platform is projected from the wall of a building, usually above the ground floor.

words.ex: The cat sat on the roof.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在屋顶上。
words.en: The roof of a building is the covering on top of it that protects the people and things inside from the weather.

words.ex: We eat dinner in the dining room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在餐厅吃晚饭。
words.en: A dining room is a room in a house where people eat their meals.

words.ex: I went to the bathroom after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 晚饭后我去了一趟浴室。
words.en: A room containing a bath or shower and typically also a washbasin and a toilet.

words.ex: They bought a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们买了一栋靠近公园的小房子。
words.en: A house is a building in which people live, usually the people belonging to one family.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.ex: The cows graze on the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 牛在牧场上吃草。
words.en: Grassland is a large open area of country covered with grass, especially one used for grazing.

words.tr: n. 厕所；洗手间；休息室；更衣室
words.ex: He went to the restroom after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后去了洗手间。
words.en: A restroom is a room in a public building with toilets and sinks for people to use.

words.ex: He was born in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: A village is a small group of houses in the country, smaller than a town.

words.ex: The children walk to school from small villages.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们从各个小村庄步行去上学。
words.en: Small communities in rural areas, typically smaller than a town.

words.tr: phrase. 花园房；建在花园中的独立小屋，通常用作休闲室、办公室或客房
words.ex: He works in the garden room every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在花园房间工作。
words.en: A garden room is a room in a house that is adjacent to a garden, designed to provide a space that combines the comfort of indoor living with the beauty and tranquility of the outdoors.

words.ex: They live in a big villa near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在海边的一座大别墅里。
words.en: A villa is a fairly large house, especially one that is used for holidays in Mediterranean countries.

words.tr: phrase. 暗室；暗房（用于冲洗照片的无光房间）
words.ex: He developed the photos in a dark room.
words.ex_cn: 他在暗室里冲洗照片。
words.en: A dark room is a room that is completely dark, used especially for developing photographs.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.tr:
n. 家；家庭；
adv. 在家；
adj. 家的；家庭的；
words.ex: I love to go home after work.
words.ex_cn: 我下班后喜欢回家。
words.en: The place where one lives permanently, especially as a member of a family or household.

words.ex: He walked up the stairs to his bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 他走上楼梯去他的卧室。
words.en: A set of steps leading from one floor of a building to another, typically inside the building.

words.ex: We booked a double room for our trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行预订了一间双人房。
words.en: A room intended for two people, typically containing a double bed.

words.ex: The toys are in the basement.
words.ex_cn: 玩具在地下室里。
words.en: The basement of a building is a room or area that is partly or completely below ground level.

words.ex: He went downstairs to get a drink.
words.ex_cn: 他下楼去拿饮料。
words.en: If you go downstairs in a building, you go down a staircase towards the ground floor.

words.ex: He waits for me on the ground floor.
words.ex_cn: 他在一楼等我。
words.en: The ground floor of a building is the floor that is at the same level as the ground outside.

words.tr: phrase. 棕榈酒廊（酒店或机场中设有棕榈装饰的休息区）
words.ex: He sits in the palm lounge and drinks juice.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在棕榈休息室里喝果汁。
words.en: A palm lounge is a relaxing area, often found in hotels or resorts, that features palm trees or a tropical theme, providing a serene environment for guests.

words.tr: phrase. 儿童房间；孩子住的房间
words.ex: The child room is painted blue with toys on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 儿童房间涂成了蓝色，地上放着玩具。
words.en: A room designed for or used by children, often for play or sleeping.

words.ex: The classroom is on the second floor.
words.ex_cn: 教室在二楼。
words.en: The level of a building that is one level above the ground floor.

words.ex: She cooks dinner in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 她在厨房里做晚饭。
words.en: A kitchen is a room or part of a room used for cooking and food preparation in a dwelling or in a commercial establishment.

words.tr: adj. 关闭的；保密的； v. 关闭；“close”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The store is closed on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店星期天关门。
words.en: If something is closed, it is not open or available to the public.

words.ex: He owns private property near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有湖边的一处私人财产。
words.en: Private property refers to property owned by individuals or entities, not by the government or the public.

words.ex: He walked through the side gate to avoid the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他从侧门走过，以避开人群。
words.en: A gate at the side of a building or property, providing an alternative entrance or exit.

words.tr:
adj. 偏远的；久远的；
n. 遥控器；
words.ex: The village is in a remote area far from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄位于远离城市的偏远地区。
words.en: Remote areas are far away from cities and places where most people live, and are therefore difficult to get to.

words.ex: He entered the building through the side entrance.
words.ex_cn: 他从侧门进入大楼。
words.en: A side entrance is a door or gate at the side of a building, used as an alternative to the main entrance.

words.ex: He does his homework at the desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在书桌上做作业。
words.en: A desk is a piece of furniture with a flat surface, typically used for writing, reading, or working on a computer.

words.tr: phrase. 最顶层的屋顶；建筑物最高处的覆盖结构
words.ex: The top roof of the building is covered with solar panels.
words.ex_cn: 这栋楼的最顶层屋顶覆盖着太阳能板。
words.en: The highest part of a roof, typically the ridge or peak.

words.ex: The boy walked down the long corridor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩走过了长长的走廊。
words.en: A corridor is a long passage in a building, with doors and rooms on one or both sides.

words.ex: The students walk through the corridors to get to class.
words.ex_cn: 学生们穿过走廊去上课。
words.en: A corridor is a long passage in a building, with doors and rooms on one or both sides.

words.ex: He waited in the foyer before the show started.
words.ex_cn: 演出开始前，他在门厅里等候。
words.en: A foyer is an area at the front of a building, especially a hotel or theater, where people can wait or meet others.

words.tr: n. 窗户；窗口；电脑窗口；“window”的复数；
words.ex: The children are looking out of the windows.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正从窗户往外看。
words.en: Windows is an operating system developed by Microsoft, which allows users to manage files and run applications on their computers.

words.ex: The self-locking door stays closed without a key.
words.ex_cn: 自锁门不用钥匙也能保持关闭。
words.en: A self-locking device or mechanism is one that locks automatically and cannot be opened without a specific action or key.

words.ex: The renovation of the old house took three months.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子的革新花了三个月。
words.en: The act of improving by renewing and restoring.

words.tr:
n. 公寓；
adj. 平坦的；扁平的；(轮胎)瘪了的；平淡无味的；
adv. 直接地；
words.ex: He lives in a small flat in London.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伦敦的一间小公寓里。
words.en: Something that is flat is level and smooth, with no curved, high, or hollow parts.

words.ex: He sleeps on a soft bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡在一张柔软的床上。
words.en: A bed is a piece of furniture that you lie on when you sleep.

words.ex: He sleeps in his bedroom every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每晚都在卧室睡觉。
words.en: A bedroom is a room in a house or apartment where people sleep.

words.ex: The stream flows quietly through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 小溪静静地流过森林。
words.en: A stream is a small, narrow river. It can also refer to a continuous flow of liquid, air, or gas, or a continuous flow of data or information.

words.tr: phrase. 大规模住房；大型住宅开发
words.ex: The government built large scale housing near the city.
words.ex_cn: 政府在城市附近建了大规模的住房。
words.en: Large scale housing refers to the development of residential buildings or complexes on a large scale, often to address housing shortages or urban expansion.

words.ex: We played chess indoors because it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 因为下雨，我们在室内下棋。
words.en: Located, done, or used inside a building.

words.ex: They enjoy countryside living because it is quiet and peaceful.
words.ex_cn: 他们喜欢乡村生活，因为那里安静而平和。
words.en: Living in rural areas, away from cities and towns, often characterized by a simpler, more natural lifestyle.

words.ex: He parked his car in the garage.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了车库里。
words.en: A garage is a building where you keep a car. It can also refer to a place where cars are repaired.

words.ex: They booked a hotel suite for their honeymoon.
words.ex_cn: 他们为蜜月预订了一间酒店套房。
words.en: A set of rooms designated for use together, especially in a hotel; a set of musical compositions designed to be performed in a sequence.

words.tr: n. 单元住宅；公寓住宅；
words.ex: He lives in a small apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一间小公寓里。
words.en: An apartment is a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a large building.

words.tr: phrase. 学生宿舍；大学宿舍
words.ex: He lives in the hall of residence near the library.
words.ex_cn: 他住在图书馆附近的宿舍楼里。
words.en: A hall of residence is a building where students live at a university or college.

words.tr: phrase. 房屋改造；房屋改建
words.ex: They are doing a house alteration to add a bathroom.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在对房子进行改造，以增加一个浴室。
words.en: The act of making changes to the structure or form of a house.

words.tr: n. 住处；膳宿；(交通工具内的)空间；
words.ex: The hotel provided cheap accommodation for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为旅客提供了便宜的住处。
words.en: Accommodation is a place where someone lives or stays, or the act of providing someone with a place to live or stay.

words.ex: The toilet is broken and needs repair.
words.ex_cn: 马桶坏了，需要修理。
words.en: A toilet is a large bowl connected to the plumbing and used for urinating and defecating, typically fitted with a seat and flushing device.

words.tr: phrase. 公共房间；公用室；公共场所
words.ex: The hotel has a public room where guests can relax.
words.ex_cn: n. 酒店有一个公共房间，客人可以在那里放松。
words.en: A room that is open to all members of a community or organization, often used for meetings, events, or relaxation.

words.ex: We have a spare room for guests.
words.ex_cn: 我们有一个空房间给客人住。
words.en: A spare room is a room in a house that is not regularly used and is available for guests to stay in.

words.ex: The students gathered in the hall for the assembly.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在大厅里集合。
words.en: A hall is a large room or building which is used for public events such as concerts, exhibitions, and meetings.

words.ex: The players go to the locker room after the game.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后，球员们去更衣室。
words.en: A locker room is a room, especially in a sports facility, where people can change their clothes and store their belongings in lockers.

words.ex: We watch TV in the living room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在客厅看电视。
words.en: A room in a house for general and informal everyday use.

words.ex: He parks his car in a lock-up garage at night.
words.ex_cn: 他晚上把车停在上锁的车库里。
words.en: A lock-up garage is a separate building from a house, typically used for storing a car or other items, which can be locked for security.

words.ex: We waited in the lounge before our flight.
words.ex_cn: 我们在登机前等在休息室里。
words.en: A lounge is a room in a house or public building where people can sit and relax. As a verb, to lounge means to lie, sit, or stand in a relaxed or lazy way.

words.tr: phrase. 蓝色的大门；蓝色门
words.ex: He waits at the blue gate after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后在蓝色的门那里等候。
words.en: A gate that is colored blue, often used for identification or decoration.

words.ex: He left the house through the back door.
words.ex_cn: 他从后门离开了房子。
words.en: A back door is a door at the back of a building, or a way of achieving something secretly or unofficially.

words.ex: He closed the door quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻地关上了门。
words.en: A door is a piece of wood, glass, or metal, which is moved to open and close the entrance to a building, room, cupboard, or vehicle.

words.ex: Many people live in urban areas.
words.ex_cn: 许多人住在城市地区。
words.en: An urban area is a geographical area characterized by higher population density and vast human features in comparison to areas surrounding it. Urban areas are created through urbanization and are categorized by urban morphology as cities, towns, conurbations or suburbs.

words.ex: We had an outdoor picnic last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 上个星期天我们进行了户外野餐。
words.en: relating to or done in the open air; not inside a building

words.tr: phrase. 共同住所；共同居住地
words.ex: They share a common residence in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们在城里共享一个住所。
words.en: A place where two or more people live together, often used in legal contexts to establish domicile or eligibility for certain benefits.

words.ex: The students relax in the common room after class.
words.ex_cn: 学生们下课后在公共休息室休息。
words.en: A common room is a room in a school, college, or university where students can relax and socialize.

words.tr: phrase. 共用浴室；多人共享的卫生间
words.ex: They have a shared bathroom on the second floor.
words.ex_cn: 他们在二楼有一个共用浴室。
words.en: A bathroom facility used by multiple people, typically in shared accommodations like hostels, dormitories, or some hotels.

words.tr:
prep. 在...外；
n. 外面；外边；外部；
adv. 在外面；
adj. 外面的；外界的；
words.ex: The cat is sitting outside the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房子外面。
words.en: The outer side or surface of something; not inside a building; external to a particular place or thing.

words.ex: We sat in the waiting room for an hour.
words.ex_cn: 我们在候诊室坐了一个小时。
words.en: A room provided for the use of people who are waiting, as for an appointment or service.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的位置；优越的地理位置
words.ex: The hotel has a good location near the train station.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店的位置很好，靠近火车站。
words.en: A place or position that is advantageous or favorable.

words.ex: They live in a quiet suburb outside the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市外一个安静的市郊。
words.en: A suburb is a residential district located on the outskirts of a city.

words.tr: n. 装饰品；装饰物；“decoration”的复数；
words.ex: The Christmas tree has many colorful decorations.
words.ex_cn: 圣诞树上有许多五彩缤纷的装饰品。
words.en: Objects or materials used to make a place look more attractive, especially something used for a special occasion or celebration.

words.ex: He goes to church every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日去教堂。
words.en: A church is a building where Christians go to worship.

words.ex: Many people go to churches on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 很多人在星期天去教堂。
words.en: Churches are buildings used for Christian religious activities, especially worship services.

words.ex: The bridge crosses the river.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥横跨河流。
words.en: A bridge is a structure that is built over a railway, river, or road so that people or vehicles can cross from one side to the other.

words.ex: The students play basketball in the sports hall.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在体育馆打篮球。
words.en: A large room or building designed for indoor sports activities.

words.ex: The streets are busy with cars and people.
words.ex_cn: 街道上汽车和行人很多。
words.en: The streets refer to public roads in a city, town, or village, typically with houses and buildings on one or both sides.

words.tr: phrase. 由地方政府提供的廉租住房；公屋
words.ex: They live in a council house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的市政住房。
words.en: A council house is a form of British public housing built by local authorities. A council estate is a building complex containing a number of council houses and other amenities like schools and shops.

words.ex: The children play in the public areas after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在公共区域玩耍。
words.en: Places that are open and accessible to all people, such as parks, streets, and public buildings.

words.tr: phrase. 国家公园；“national park”的复数
words.ex: Many families visit national parks on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭在周末参观国家公园。
words.en: National parks are areas of land protected by the government for the conservation of wildlife, plants, and landscapes, and for public enjoyment and recreation.

words.ex: The meeting will be held at the town hall.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在市政厅举行。
words.en: A town hall is a building used for the administration of local government, or a meeting at which a public official or political candidate addresses an audience.

words.ex: He was sent to prison for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃被送进了监狱。
words.en: A prison is a building where criminals are kept as punishment or where people accused of a crime are kept before their trial.

words.tr: phrase. 春季公园；春天时开放或景色宜人的公园
words.ex: We walk in spring park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上在春日公园散步。
words.en: A public park or recreational area that features natural springs, often used for leisure activities and relaxation.

words.ex: He closed the gate before it rained.
words.ex_cn: 下雨前他关上了门。
words.en: A gate is a structure like a door which is used at the entrance to a field, a garden, or the grounds of a building.

words.tr: phrase. 交通博物馆（展示交通工具历史与发展的博物馆）
words.ex: We visited the transport museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了交通博物馆。
words.en: A museum that displays collections related to the history and development of transportation, including vehicles, technology, and infrastructure.

words.tr: phrase. 工会会所；联合住宅（指供工会或联合组织使用的建筑）
words.ex: The workers met at the union house to discuss their pay.
words.ex_cn: 工人们在工会会所开会讨论他们的工资。
words.en: A building or room used as a meeting place by a trade union or labor union.

words.tr: phrase. 中心方形：用于找到圆心的直尺和滑动方块的组合。
words.ex: He used a center square to find the exact center of the circle.
words.ex_cn: 他使用中心方形来找到圆的精确中心。
words.en: The middle area of a square, often used in games or layouts.

words.tr: phrase. 颐和园（中国北京市的一座著名皇家园林）
words.ex: They visited the Summer Palace last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们上周末参观了颐和园。
words.en: The Summer Palace is a vast ensemble of lakes, gardens and palaces in Beijing. It serves as a popular tourist destination and a recreational park.

words.ex: We arrived at the airport early.
words.ex_cn: 我们早早到达了机场。
words.en: An airport is a place where aircraft regularly take off and land, with buildings for passengers to wait in.

words.ex: He goes to university to study engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他上大学学习工程。
words.en: A university is an institution where students study for degrees and where academic research is done.

words.ex: He went to the hospital because he felt sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为感觉不舒服去了医院。
words.en: A hospital is a place where people who are ill or injured are treated and taken care of by doctors and nurses.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；舞台；
v. 举行；上演；
words.ex: This is a critical stage in his recovery.
words.ex_cn: 这是他康复过程中的一个关键阶段。
words.en: A stage is a raised area in a theatre or hall where performers, speakers, or entertainers stand. It can also refer to a particular point or period in the development or progress of something.

words.ex: I deposited money at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 我到银行存了钱。
words.en: A bank is an institution where people or businesses can keep their money or borrow money. It can also refer to the land alongside a river or lake.

words.ex: The children play at Nursery 796.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在796号托儿所玩耍。
words.en: A nursery is a place where young children are cared for during the day while their parents are at work.

words.ex: I wait for the bus at station 15.
words.ex_cn: 我在15号车站等公交车。
words.en: A station is a place where trains, buses, or other vehicles regularly stop so that people can get on or off, or where a particular activity or service is based.

words.ex: She plants flowers in her garden.
words.ex_cn: 她在花园里种花。
words.en: A garden is a piece of land next to a house, with flowers, vegetables, other plants, and often grass.

words.ex: The crowd cheered loudly at the stadium.
words.ex_cn: 观众在体育场里大声欢呼。
words.en: A stadium is a large structure for open-air sports or entertainments, consisting of a field or stage surrounded partly or completely by a tiered structure designed to allow spectators to stand or sit and view the event.

words.tr:
n. 架子；支架；齿条；破坏
v. 折磨；使痛苦；放在架上；累计（得分）
words.ex: He put the books on the rack.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在架子上。
words.en: A rack is a frame or shelf, usually with bars or hooks, that is used for holding things or for hanging things on. As a verb, to rack something means to cause great pain or suffering to someone.

words.ex: He puts the books on the racks every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上把书放在架子上。
words.en: A rack is a frame or shelf, usually with bars, hooks, or pegs, for holding or storing things. It can also refer to a state of great distress or suffering.

words.tr: phrase. 自行车架；用于停放自行车的架子
words.ex: The bike racks are full near the school.
words.ex_cn: 学校附近的自行车架都满了。
words.en: Bike racks are structures used to park bicycles securely.

words.ex: We went to a state park to hike and see animals.
words.ex_cn: 我们去州立公园徒步并看动物。
words.en: A state park is an area of land or water that is protected by a state government for the enjoyment of the public or the preservation of wildlife.

words.ex: They walk to the town center every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每个星期六都步行去镇中心。
words.en: The main area of a town where most of the shops, businesses, and other facilities are located.

words.ex: The city needs better infrastructure for roads and water.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要更好的道路和供水设施。
words.en: The basic physical and organizational structures and facilities (e.g., buildings, roads, power supplies) needed for the operation of a society or enterprise.

words.tr: phrase. 信息中心；问询处；资料中心
words.ex: The information center provided maps and brochures for tourists.
words.ex_cn: 信息中心为游客提供了地图和小册子。
words.en: A place where people can obtain information on a particular subject or about a particular organization.

words.ex: We visited the local museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了当地博物馆。
words.en: A small museum that focuses on the history, culture, or artifacts of a specific town, city, or region.

words.ex: We visited the zoo to see the lions.
words.ex_cn: 我们去动物园看狮子。
words.en: A place where live animals are kept so that people can go to look at them.

words.tr: n. 历史遗迹；纪念碑；不朽作品；
words.ex: The ancient monument attracts many tourists each year.
words.ex_cn: 这座古代历史遗迹每年吸引许多游客。
words.en: A monument is a large structure, usually made of stone, which is built to remind people of an important person or event.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们周日参观了一家艺术画廊。
words.en: A gallery is a place where works of art are shown to the public.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日参观了一个美术馆。
words.en: A place where works of art are displayed for public viewing.

words.tr: phrase. 新歌剧；现代歌剧；新式歌剧作品
words.ex: They are watching a new opera this evening.
words.ex_cn: 他们今晚要看一部新歌剧。
words.en: A new opera refers to a recently composed opera, often characterized by innovative themes, music, and staging techniques.

words.tr: phrase. 教育中心；教学中心
words.ex: The children go to the education centre after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后去教育中心。
words.en: A place where teaching and learning activities, especially for children or adults, are organized and conducted.

words.ex: We went to the theater to watch a play.
words.ex_cn: 我们去剧院看了一场话剧。
words.en: A theater is a building with a stage in it, on which plays, shows, and other performances take place.

words.ex: He goes to the library every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午去图书馆。
words.en: A library is a building where books, documents, CDs, and sometimes videos and music are kept for people to read, study, or borrow.

words.tr: n. 设施；特色功能；特定场所；资质；
words.ex: The school has a new sports facility.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有一个新的体育设施。
words.en: A facility is a place, building, or service that is designed for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He went to the post office to send a letter.
words.ex_cn: 他去邮局寄信。
words.en: A post office is a public department or corporation responsible for mail services, including the acceptance, transmission, and delivery of letters and parcels.

words.tr:
n. 公园；园区；
v. 停放；停车；
words.ex: We walk our dog in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上在公园遛狗。
words.en: A park is a large area of land with grass and trees, usually in a town, where people go in order to relax and enjoy themselves. To park a vehicle means to leave it somewhere for a period of time.

words.ex: He parked his car in the car park.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了停车场。
words.en: A car park is an area or building where people can leave their cars.

words.tr: phrase. 健康中心；医疗中心
words.ex: I go to the health center for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 我去健康中心做体检。
words.en: A health center is a place where people can receive medical care, health education, and other health-related services. It often serves as the primary point of contact for individuals seeking health services in a community.

words.ex: We visited a museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个博物馆。
words.en: A museum is a building where a large number of interesting and valuable objects, such as works of art or historical items, are kept, studied, and displayed to the public.

words.ex: We visited a space museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们参观了一个太空博物馆。
words.en: A space museum is a museum that focuses on the history and science of space exploration and astronomy.

words.tr:
n. 市中心区；商业区；
adv. 在市区；往市区；
words.ex: We went downtown to buy some clothes.
words.ex_cn: 我们去市中心买了一些衣服。
words.en: Downtown refers to the central part or main business and commercial area of a city or town.

words.ex: My brother goes to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天早上上学。
words.en: A school is an institution where children are educated.

words.ex: The children ran to the emergency exit.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们跑向紧急出口。
words.en: An emergency exit is a door or other way out of a building, vehicle, or other place, that is used in an emergency.

words.ex: The children are playing on the playground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在游乐场上玩耍。
words.en: A playground is an area designed for children to play in, especially at a school or in a park.

words.tr: phrase. 行政办公楼；行政管理用建筑
words.ex: The administrative buildings are near the main gate.
words.ex_cn: 行政大楼在主大门附近。
words.en: Buildings or parts of buildings used for management, clerical work, and organizational tasks.

words.ex: The students are in the new classroom.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在新教室里。
words.en: A room or space recently created or designated for teaching and learning purposes.

words.tr: phrase. 百货商店；百货公司
words.ex: She bought a dress at the department store.
words.ex_cn: 她在百货商店买了一条裙子。
words.en: A large shop divided into several different areas, each of which sells different types of goods.

words.tr: phrase. 小商店；小型零售店
words.ex: He works in a small shop near his house.
words.ex_cn: 他在家附近的一家小店工作。
words.en: A small retail establishment selling a limited range of goods, typically in a local area.

words.ex: He goes to the night club on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末去夜总会。
words.en: A night club is a place where people go late in the evening to drink and dance.

words.ex: He buys fresh fish at the fish market.
words.ex_cn: 他在鱼市买新鲜的鱼。
words.en: A place where fish and seafood are sold.

words.ex: He buys lunch in the school canteen.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校食堂买午餐。
words.en: A canteen is a place in a factory, office, or school where meals are served, often at a lower cost than in restaurants. It can also refer to a small container for carrying water or other drinks.

words.ex: The boxes are stored in the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 这些箱子存放在仓库里。
words.en: A warehouse is a large building where raw materials or manufactured goods may be stored before their export or distribution for sale.

words.ex: He buys a novel at the bookshop.
words.ex_cn: 他在书店买了一本小说。
words.en: A shop where books are sold.

words.tr:
n. 市场；行情；商场；销路；
v. 营销；
words.ex: The market sells fresh vegetables every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场每天早上卖新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: A market is a place where goods are bought and sold, or an area or country where there is a demand for particular goods or services.

words.ex: We ate dinner at a small restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在一家小餐厅吃了晚饭。
words.en: A restaurant is a place where you can eat a meal and pay for it. In restaurants, your food is usually served to you at your table by a waiter or waitress.

words.ex: He drinks coffee at a small cafe.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小咖啡馆喝咖啡。
words.en: A cafe is a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗衣店；
words.ex: I put the dirty laundry in the washing machine.
words.ex_cn: 我把脏衣服放进洗衣机里。
words.en: Laundry refers to the clothes and linens that need to be washed or that have just been washed. It can also refer to the place or business where clothes and linens are washed and ironed.

words.tr: phrase. 露天市场；户外集市
words.ex: We buy fresh fruit at the open-air market every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们每个星期天在露天市场买新鲜水果。
words.en: Market held in an open, unroofed space.

words.tr: phrase. 训练工作室；培训工作室
words.ex: He goes to the training studio every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去训练工作室。
words.en: A facility or room where physical training, exercise, and fitness activities are conducted.

words.ex: They stayed at a motel near the highway.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在高速公路旁的一家汽车旅馆。
words.en: A motel is a hotel which is designed for people who are travelling by car, usually with parking spaces next to each room.

words.ex: He goes to the gym every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身房。
words.en: A gym is a place equipped for physical exercise and training, especially for athletes or for people who want to keep fit.

words.ex: We stayed at a small hotel near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们住在海边一家小旅馆里。
words.en: A hotel is a building where people stay, for example on holiday, paying for their rooms and meals.

words.tr: phrase. 商业区；大商场；大型购物中心
words.ex: We went to the shopping mall to buy clothes and eat dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们去商业区买衣服和吃晚饭。
words.en: A shopping mall is a large building or group of buildings containing a variety of stores and often restaurants and other business establishments situated close together.

words.ex: He joins a chess club after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部。
words.en: A club is an organization of people with a common purpose or interest, who meet regularly and take part in shared activities. It can also refer to a heavy stick used as a weapon or for hitting a ball in sports.

words.ex: We went to the cinema last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去看了电影。
words.en: A cinema is a place where people go to watch films. It can also refer to the art and industry of making films.

words.tr: phrase. 汽车加油站；“petrol station”的复数
words.ex: He stops at petrol stations to fill his car.
words.ex_cn: 他停在加油站给车加油。
words.en: A place where petrol is sold, typically also offering other services such as car washing and minor repairs.

words.ex: He used a payphone to call his mom.
words.ex_cn: 他用投币电话给妈妈打电话。
words.en: A payphone is a public telephone that you pay to use by putting coins into a slot or by using a card.

words.ex: He buys fries from a fast food shop near his house.
words.ex_cn: 他在他家附近的一家快餐店买薯条。
words.en: A fast food shop is a type of restaurant that serves fast food cuisine and has minimal table service.

words.tr: phrase. 商务中心；商业中心
words.ex: He went to the business center to print his report.
words.ex_cn: 他去商务中心打印他的报告。
words.en: A business center is a place where business services such as secretarial support, conference rooms, and office equipment are provided to business people.

words.ex: The toy factory makes small cars for children.
words.ex_cn: 玩具工厂为孩子们制造小汽车。
words.en: A toy factory is a place where toys are manufactured.

words.ex: We stayed at a small inn near the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 我们住在山附近的一家小客栈里。
words.en: A small hotel, usually in the countryside, where you can stay the night and have meals.

words.tr: n. 自助餐厅；自助食堂；
words.ex: We ate lunch in the school cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 我们在学校自助餐厅吃午饭。
words.en: A cafeteria is a type of food service location within an institution in which there is little or no waiting staff table service, whether a restaurant or within an institution such as a large office building or school; a school dining location is also referred to as a dining hall or canteen (in British English).

words.ex: The teacher keeps extra books in the storeroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师把多余的书放在贮藏室里。
words.en: A room or area where items are stored.

words.tr: phrase. 行李寄存柜；寄存行李用的储物柜
words.ex: He put his bag in a left-luggage locker at the station.
words.ex_cn: 他把包放在了车站的寄存柜里。
words.en: Secure lockers or compartments in a station, airport, or hotel where travellers can store luggage temporarily.

words.ex: I buy milk and bread at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A large self-service store selling foods and household goods.

words.tr: phrase. 价格实惠的餐厅；便宜的餐馆
words.ex: We ate at an inexpensive restaurant near the park.
words.ex_cn: 我们在公园附近一家便宜的餐馆吃了饭。
words.en: A restaurant where meals and drinks are offered at a low price, often with a simple menu.

words.ex: He bought medicine at the chemist's.
words.ex_cn: 他在药房买了药。
words.en: A chemist's is a shop where medicines and other health-related products are sold, and where prescriptions can be filled.

words.tr: phrase. 水疗中心；温泉疗养中心
words.ex: They go to the spa centre to relax.
words.ex_cn: 他们去水疗中心放松。
words.en: A facility or centre offering health and beauty treatments, such as massages, facials, and hydrotherapy.

words.ex: He drinks coffee at the coffee bar every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在咖啡吧喝咖啡。
words.en: A coffee bar is an establishment that primarily serves coffee and other hot beverages, often with light snacks and pastries.

words.tr:
n. 平方；广场；正方形；四方形；
adj. 正方形的；四方形的；平方的；成直角的；
v. 与...一致；
adv. 成直角地；
words.ex: The area of the room is 16 square.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的面积是16平方米。
words.en: A square is a shape with four sides of equal length and four angles of 90 degrees. It can also refer to an open area in a town, often used for public events, or to the result of multiplying a number by itself.

words.tr:
n. 裂缝；噼啪声；
v. 破裂；
words.ex: There is a small crack in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 墙上有一条小裂缝。
words.en: If something hard cracks, or if you crack it, it becomes slightly damaged, with lines appearing on its surface.

words.ex: He works in a small studio near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近的一个小工作室工作。
words.en: A studio is a room where an artist, photographer, or designer works, or a place where movies or television programs are made.

words.ex: The train went through a long tunnel.
words.ex_cn: 火车通过了一条长长的隧道。
words.en: A tunnel is a long passage which has been made under or through the ground, usually through a hill or under a river, to allow people or vehicles to travel through it.

words.ex: The foundation gives money to poor students.
words.ex_cn: 这个基金会向贫困学生提供资金。
words.en: The foundation of something such as a belief or way of life is the things on which it is based.

words.ex: They used cement to build the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他们用水泥建造了这堵墙。
words.en: Cement is a powdery substance which is mixed with water and used for sticking things together or for making very hard surfaces.

words.ex: The wheelchair goes up the ramp easily.
words.ex_cn: 轮椅可以轻松地走上坡道。
words.en: A ramp is a sloping surface connecting two levels, such as a road or a path.

words.ex: The relocation of the factory caused many job changes.
words.ex_cn: 工厂的迁移导致了许多工作变动。
words.en: The act of moving to a new place and establishing one's home or business there.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.ex: The construction of the new bridge took two years.
words.ex_cn: 新桥的建筑花了两年时间。
words.en: The process or method of building or making something, especially buildings, bridges, etc.

words.ex: He nailed the wood boards to the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把木板钉在墙上。
words.en: Planks of wood; a group of people who manage or direct a company or organization; the stage in a theater.

words.tr:
n. 清漆；漆面；光泽面
v. 给…涂上清漆
words.ex: He put varnish on the wooden table.
words.ex_cn: 他在木桌上涂了清漆。
words.en: Varnish is a transparent, hard, protective finish or film primarily used in wood finishing but also for other materials. Varnish is traditionally a combination of a drying oil, a resin, and a thinner or solvent.

words.ex: They will rebuild the house after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他们将在风暴后重建这座房子。
words.en: To rebuild something means to build it again after it has been damaged or destroyed.

words.ex: The layout of the room makes it feel bigger.
words.ex_cn: 房间的布局让它显得更大。
words.en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged or laid out.

words.tr: phrase. 主工作室；主演播室；主画室
words.ex: The main studio is where the live broadcasts are produced.
words.ex_cn: 中心播送室是制作直播节目的地方。
words.en: The primary room or facility where a film, television, or recording is produced.

words.ex: They settled in a small village after retirement.
words.ex_cn: 他们退休后在一个小村庄安顿下来。
words.en: To settle means to resolve or come to an agreement about a dispute, to establish a permanent home in a particular place, or to come to rest in a particular position.

words.ex: The entrance to the building is on the left.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的入口在左边。
words.en: An entrance is a way into a place, such as a door or gate. It can also refer to the act of entering a place or the right to enter.

words.tr:
n. 大楼；大厦；块；街区；障碍物；
v. 阻塞；阻碍；
words.ex: The new block is next to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这栋新大楼就在公园旁边。
words.en: A block is a large solid piece of material with flat surfaces on each side. As a verb, to block means to prevent movement or progress.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.ex: He waited at the reception desk for his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他在接待台等他的朋友。
words.en: In a hotel, at the front desk or counter where guests check in, check out, and seek information or assistance.

words.tr: n. 加热；供暖设备；采暖； v. 加热；“heat”的现在分词；
words.ex: The heating of the room takes five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 房间的加热需要五分钟。
words.en: The process of making something warm or hot, or the system that does this.

words.ex: He put his head on the pillow and fell asleep.
words.ex_cn: 他把头放在枕头上，睡着了。
words.en: A pillow is a cushion that you rest your head on when you are in bed.

words.tr:
n. 热度；热；
v. 加热；
words.ex: The heat of the sun made the road hot.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的热度让路面变得很热。
words.en: Heat is a form of energy that is transferred by a difference in temperature. It can also refer to the level of excitement or intensity in a situation.

words.ex: He sits by the fireplace in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天他坐在壁炉旁。
words.en: A fireplace is a place built into a wall where you can have a fire, especially in a house.

words.ex: I take a shower every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上都洗淋浴。
words.en: A shower is a device that sprays water over you so that you can wash yourself. It is also a short period of rain or snow.

words.ex: She looked at herself in the mirror.
words.ex_cn: 她对着镜子看自己。
words.en: A mirror is a flat piece of glass which reflects light, so that when you look at it you can see yourself reflected in it.

words.ex: He turned on the air-conditioner to cool the room.
words.ex_cn: 他打开了空调来让房间凉快。
words.en: An air-conditioner is a machine that keeps the air in a building cool and dry.

words.ex: He bought a recorder to record his lessons.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一台录音机来录课程。
words.en: A recorder is a device or a person that records something, especially sounds or events.

words.ex: He forgot the keys to the locks.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了锁的钥匙。
words.en: Locks are devices used to secure doors, containers, etc., and can also refer to sections of a canal or river where the water level changes, controlled by gates.

words.ex: He took the elevator to the 10th floor.
words.ex_cn: 他乘电梯上了十楼。
words.en: An elevator is a device that moves people or goods up and down inside a building.

words.ex: He wrote his name on a sheet of paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在一张纸上写了名字。
words.en: A sheet is a large piece of thin cloth used on a bed to lie on or under. It can also refer to a flat, thin piece of material, such as paper, metal, or glass.

words.ex: The dog jumped over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 狗跳过了栅栏。
words.en: A fence is a barrier between two areas of land, made of wood or wire supported by posts. If you fence an area of land, you surround it with a fence.

words.ex: The walls are white.
words.ex_cn: 墙是白色的。
words.en: A wall is a vertical structure, often made of stone or brick, that divides or encloses an area of land.

words.ex: This portable charger works well on trips.
words.ex_cn: 这个便携式充电器在旅行时很好用。
words.en: Capable of being carried or moved about with ease.

words.tr:
prep. 在…周围；环绕；
adv. 环绕；附近；
adj. 圆的；十足的；
n. 回合；圆形物；
v. 拐过；使成圆形；
words.ex: The children sat round the fire.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们围坐在火堆旁。
words.en: Something that is round is shaped like a circle or a ball.

words.tr: adj. 家庭的；国内的；驯养的；
words.ex: She prefers domestic chores over going out.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢做家务而不是外出。
words.en: Domestic means relating to the home, family, or household affairs. It can also refer to something that is made or produced within a country and not imported.

words.tr: n. 椅子；“chair”的复数； v. 主持；
words.ex: The students sat on the chairs in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 学生们坐在教室的椅子上。
words.en: A chair is a piece of furniture for one person to sit on, with a back and usually four legs.

words.ex: She pulled the curtains to block the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 她拉上窗帘以挡住阳光。
words.en: Curtains are pieces of material that hang from the top of a window and can be drawn across it to cover it.

words.tr:
v. 举起；提起；抬起；
n. 电梯；搭便车；
words.ex: He lift the box with both hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用双手举起箱子。
words.en: To lift something means to move it to a higher position. A lift is a device that carries people or goods up and down inside buildings.

words.ex: He pulled the keys from the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他从抽屉里拿出钥匙。
words.en: A drawer is a sliding container that fits into a piece of furniture, such as a desk or chest, and is used for storing things.

words.ex: They bought new wallpaper for the bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 他们为卧室买了新壁纸。
words.en: Wallpaper is a material used to cover and decorate the interior walls of homes, offices, and other buildings; it is usually sold in rolls and is applied onto the wall using wallpaper paste.

words.ex: He walks on the carpet every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都走在地毯上。
words.en: A carpet is a thick covering of soft material which is laid over a floor or a staircase.

words.tr:
n. 毛毯；厚的覆盖物；
adj. 包括所有的；
words.ex: He wrapped himself in a warm blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己裹在一条温暖的毛毯里。
words.en: A blanket is a large piece of woolen or similar material used as a covering on a bed or elsewhere for warmth.

words.ex: He put a mat on the floor to keep it clean.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上放了一块垫子以保持清洁。
words.en: A mat is a piece of thick fabric or other material that is placed on a floor or other surface to protect it or to provide a soft surface to stand or sit on.

words.ex: She turned on the lamp to read a book.
words.ex_cn: 她打开灯来读书。
words.en: A lamp is a device that produces light by the flow of electric current, or by burning oil or gas.

words.ex: He will fix the broken chair tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会修理那把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: To fix something means to repair it, to make it firm or stable, or to arrange or decide it.

words.ex: The bath is next to the bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 浴室在卧室旁边。
words.en: A bath is the process of washing your body, usually by sitting or lying in a container of water.

words.ex: He washed his hands in the washbasin.
words.ex_cn: 他在洗脸盆里洗手。
words.en: A washbasin is a large bowl, usually with taps for hot and cold water, used for washing your hands and face.

words.ex: He kept the dishes in the cabinet.
words.ex_cn: 他把盘子放在储藏柜里。
words.en: A cabinet is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves or drawers, used for storing or showing things. In politics, a cabinet is a group of people who are chosen by a head of state to give advice and to help set government policy.

words.ex: He went upstairs to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他上楼去睡觉了。
words.en: If you go upstairs in a building, you go up a staircase towards a higher floor.

words.tr: v. 布置家具；“furnish”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 配备家具的；
words.ex: They furnished the apartment with new tables and chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他们给公寓布置了新的桌椅。
words.en: If a room or building is furnished, it is equipped with furniture.

words.ex: He sits in the armchair and reads the newspaper.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在扶手椅上读报纸。
words.en: An armchair is a comfortable chair with sides that support your arms.

words.tr: n. 电视节目；电视行业；电视机；
words.ex: He watches television every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看电视节目。
words.en: A system for transmitting visual images and sound that are reproduced on screens, chiefly used to broadcast programs for entertainment, information, and education.

words.ex: The room has new furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有新家具。
words.en: Furniture refers to the movable objects intended to support various human activities such as seating, eating, and sleeping.

words.ex: He watches tv every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看电视。
words.en: A system for transmitting visual images and sound that are reproduced on screens, chiefly used to broadcast programs for entertainment, information, and education.

words.ex: The designer's desk is messy with papers and pens.
words.ex_cn: 设计师的桌子堆满了纸张和笔。
words.en: A desk used by a designer for creating and planning work.

words.tr: n. 纸板盒；箱数（carton 的复数形式）; v. 用纸板箱包装；制作纸箱（carton 的第三...
words.ex: He carries three cartons of milk to the car.
words.ex_cn: 他搬了三箱牛奶到车里。
words.en: Cartons are boxes made from thick paper, often used for packaging goods.

words.tr: n. 陶器；制陶手艺；陶器作坊；
words.ex: He makes pottery in his backyard studio.
words.ex_cn: 他在后院的工作室制作陶器。
words.en: Objects such as pots, dishes, and vases that are made out of clay and then baked at high temperatures to make them hard.

words.ex: He dried his hands with a towel.
words.ex_cn: 他用毛巾擦干手。
words.en: A towel is a piece of thick soft cloth that you use to dry yourself with.

words.ex: She dried her hands with clean towels.
words.ex_cn: 她用干净的毛巾擦干手。
words.en: A towel is a piece of thick absorbent cloth or paper used for drying oneself or wiping things dry.

words.tr:
n. 警报；闹钟；惊慌；
v. 使惊恐；
words.ex: The fire alarm rang loudly.
words.ex_cn: 火警警报大声响了起来。
words.en: An alarm is a warning of danger, often given by a bell or flashing light.

words.tr:
n. 喷雾；
v. 喷洒；
words.ex: She used a spray to clean the window.
words.ex_cn: 她用喷雾清洁了窗户。
words.en: Spray can refer to a liquid that is blown or driven through the air in the form of tiny drops, or to the act of applying such a liquid.

words.ex: He took a photo of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他拍了一张日落的照片。
words.en: A photo is a picture that is made using a camera.

words.tr: n. （有锁的）寄物柜；锁柜；上锁的人
words.ex: He put his books in the locker.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在储物柜里。
words.en: A locker is a small storage compartment, typically in a public place such as a school, gym, or workplace, where individuals can store their personal belongings securely.

words.tr:
adj. 臭虫多的
n. 轻型马车；婴儿车
words.ex: The old cabin is buggy after the summer rain.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧小屋在夏雨后虫子很多。
words.en: A buggy is a small, lightweight vehicle, often open and with four wheels, used for recreation or transportation over rough terrain.

words.tr:
n. 笔记；便条；音调；注释；语气；
v. 注意；记录；
words.ex: I took notes during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我在讲座期间做了笔记。
words.en: A note is a short piece of writing, a musical sound, or a piece of paper money. It can also mean to pay attention to something or to write something down.

words.tr:
adj. 关键的；
n. 钥匙；关键；
words.ex: This is a key step to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是解决问题的关键步骤。
words.en: A key is a specially shaped piece of metal that you place in a lock and turn in order to open or lock a door, or to start or stop the engine of a vehicle.

words.ex: She buys new brushes for her painting.
words.ex_cn: 她为绘画买了新刷子。
words.en: Brushes are tools with bristles, wire, or other filaments, used for cleaning, grooming, painting, or other purposes. As a verb, it means to clean, smooth, or apply something with a brush.

words.ex: She put the apples in a basket.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个篮子里。
words.en: A basket is a container which is usually made of stiff fibers, such as rushes, straw, or thin strips of wood, and is used for carrying or storing things.

words.tr: n. 容器；集装箱；“container”的复数；
words.ex: The boxes are containers for the toys.
words.ex_cn: 这些盒子是装玩具的容器。
words.en: A container is something such as a box or bottle that is used to hold or store things in.

words.ex: He tied the box with a strong rope.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根结实的绳子把箱子绑了起来。
words.en: A rope is a thick cord made by twisting together strands of natural fibers such as hemp or artificial fibers such as nylon.

words.tr:
n. 座位；
v. 使坐下；
words.ex: Please take your seat before the class starts.
words.ex_cn: 上课前请坐好你的座位。
words.en: A seat is an object that you can sit on, for example a chair.

words.tr:
v. 转换；
n. 开关；
words.ex: He switched off the light before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前把灯关掉了。
words.en: A switch is a small control for an electrical device which you use to turn the device on or off.

words.tr:
n. 框架；结构；骨架；模式；
v. 表达；陷害；
words.ex: The picture is in a wooden frame.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画在一个木制框架里。
words.en: A frame is a structure that forms a border or support for something, such as a picture or a window. It can also refer to the process of making or constructing something, or the act of falsely incriminating someone.

words.ex: He put the milk in the fridge.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶放进冰箱里。
words.en: A fridge is a large container which is kept cool inside, usually by electricity, so that the food and drink in it stays fresh.

words.ex: He lit a candle to see in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他点燃了一支蜡烛以便在黑暗中看见。
words.en: A candle is a stick of wax with a wick through the middle which is lit to give light as it burns.

words.ex: He picked up the telephone to call his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起电话给妈妈打电话。
words.en: A telephone is a device that you use to speak to someone in another place by dialing a number. It converts sound into electrical signals that can be sent over long distances.

words.tr: phrase. 饮水机；（非正式）办公室闲聊场所
words.ex: He talks with coworkers at the water cooler.
words.ex_cn: 他在饮水机旁和同事聊天。
words.en: A water cooler is a device that cools and dispenses water for drinking.

words.ex: She uses a hair dryer every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上都用吹风机。
words.en: A hair dryer is an electrical device used to blow hot or cool air over wet hair to speed the evaporation of water to dry the hair.

words.ex: She tied the box with a thin string.
words.ex_cn: 她用一根细线把盒子绑了起来。
words.en: A string is a thin piece of rope or cord, or a series of things connected together.

words.ex: She put the dirty plates into the dishwasher.
words.ex_cn: 她把脏盘子放进洗碗机里。
words.en: A dishwasher is a machine that washes dirty dishes automatically.

words.tr:
n. 粘附物；胶粘物；不干胶标签；贴纸；不屈不挠的人
v. 给…贴上标签价
words.ex: He put a sticker on his notebook.
words.ex_cn: 他在笔记本上贴了一个粘附物。
words.en: A sticker is a small piece of paper or plastic with a picture or writing on one side and glue on the other side, which you can stick onto a surface.

words.ex: He spilled ink on his shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他把墨水洒在了衬衫上。
words.en: Ink is the colored liquid used for writing, printing, or drawing.

words.ex: He spoke into the microphone to be heard clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他对着麦克风说话，以便被清楚地听到。
words.en: A microphone is a device that is used to make sounds louder or to record them.

words.tr:
n. 照片；相片；
v. 拍照；
words.ex: He showed me a photograph of his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他给我看了他狗的照片。
words.en: A photograph is a picture that is made using a camera.

words.ex: The teacher turned on the projector to show the video.
words.ex_cn: 老师打开投影仪来播放视频。
words.en: A projector is a machine that projects films or slides onto a screen or wall.

words.tr: n. 洗涤剂；洗衣粉；去垢剂；
words.ex: She uses detergent to wash the clothes.
words.ex_cn: 她用洗涤剂洗衣服。
words.en: A detergent is a substance that is used for cleaning things, especially clothes and dishes.

words.ex: He used a torch to find his keys in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他用手电筒在黑暗中找钥匙。
words.en: A torch is a stick with a flame on one end that is used as a source of light, or a portable battery-powered electric lamp.

words.tr: n. 图像；形象；画面；影像；
words.ex: The photo shows a clear image of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了山脉的清晰图像。
words.en: An image is a picture that you have in your mind, especially about what someone or something is like or the way they look.

words.ex: He looked up the number in the phonebook.
words.ex_cn: 他在电话簿里查找了那个号码。
words.en: A phonebook is a book that contains an alphabetical list of the names, addresses, and telephone numbers of the people in a particular area.

words.ex: He threw the rubbish into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: Waste material; refuse or litter.

words.tr: n. 垃圾；无价值的东西；
words.ex: The trash bin is full.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾桶满了。
words.en: Waste material or unwanted things that are thrown away.

words.ex: She put a cushion on the chair to make it comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个靠垫，让它更舒服。
words.en: A cushion is a soft bag of some ornamental material, stuffed with wool, hair, feathers, polyester staple fiber, non-woven material, or even paper torn into fragments. It may be used for sitting or kneeling upon, or to soften the hardness or angularity of a chair or couch.

words.ex: This jacket is waterproof.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克是防水的。
words.en: Something that is waterproof does not let water pass through it.

words.ex: He washes his hands with soap.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥皂洗手。
words.en: A substance used with water for washing and cleaning, made of a compound of natural oils or fats with sodium hydroxide or another strong alkali, and typically also perfume and coloring.

words.ex: He blew a whistle to get our attention.
words.ex_cn: 他吹了一声口哨来引起我们的注意。
words.en: A whistle is a small metal tube which you blow in order to produce a loud sound and attract someone's attention. A whistle is also the sound that you make when you blow a whistle or when you whistle.

words.ex: He uses a pencil to write his name.
words.ex_cn: 他用铅笔写自己的名字。
words.en: A pencil is an instrument that you use for writing or drawing, consisting of a thin stick of wood with a rod of a black or coloured substance through the middle.

words.tr:
n. 胶；胶水；
v. 粘合；
words.ex: He used glue to stick the paper together.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶把纸粘在一起。
words.en: A sticky substance used for joining things together.

words.ex: He used a stopwatch to time the race.
words.ex_cn: 他用秒表计时比赛。
words.en: A stopwatch is a watch that can be started and stopped by pressing a button, used for timing events accurately.

words.tr:
n. 光；灯；光线；
adj. 轻的；浅的；少量的；明亮的；
v. 点燃；照亮；
words.ex: The light from the window brightened the room.
words.ex_cn: 窗户透进来的光让房间变亮了。
words.en: Light is the natural agent that stimulates sight and makes things visible. It is also used to describe something that is not heavy or a source of illumination.

words.tr:
adj. 蓝色的；
n. 蓝色；
words.ex: The sky is blue today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是蓝色的。
words.en: Blue is a color that is between green and violet in the spectrum of visible light. It is also used to describe something that is sad or depressed.

words.tr:
adj. 绿色的；未熟的；无经验的；
n. 绿色；
words.ex: The leaves are green in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，树叶是绿色的。
words.en: Green is the color between blue and yellow in the spectrum. It is the color of growing grass and leaves.

words.tr:
adj. 黑暗的；暗色的；深色的；
n. 黑暗；夜；暗色；
words.ex: The room was dark after the power went out.
words.ex_cn: 停电后，房间变得黑暗。
words.en: The absence of light in a place is referred to as dark. It can also describe something that is not light in color, or something that is mysterious or difficult to understand.

words.tr:
adj. 紫色的；
n. 紫色；
words.ex: The flower is purple.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花是紫色的。
words.en: Purple is a color that is a mixture of red and blue.

words.ex: The golden sun set behind the hills.
words.ex_cn: 金色的太阳在山后落下。
words.en: Something that is golden is bright yellow in color, like gold. It can also describe something that is very good or valuable.

words.ex: A sliver of wood stuck in his finger.
words.ex_cn: 一小片木头扎进了他的手指。
words.en: A sliver is a small, thin piece of something that has been cut, broken, or torn off from a larger piece.

words.ex: The color of the sky is blue.
words.ex_cn: 天空的颜色是蓝色的。
words.en: Color is the appearance that things have that results from the way in which they reflect light.

words.tr: n. 彩色；颜料；脸色；脸色（color 的复数）；
words.ex: The children love to paint with bright colors.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢用鲜艳的彩色画画。
words.en: Colors are the different hues that can be seen in light and pigment, and are used to describe the appearance of objects.

words.ex: She put cream on her coffee.
words.ex_cn: 她在咖啡里加了奶油。
words.en: Cream is the thick white or pale yellow fatty liquid which rises to the top when you boil milk, and which you can use in cooking or as a cosmetic.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲；曲线；
v. （使）弯成弧形；
words.ex: The road has a sharp curve ahead.
words.ex_cn: 前面的路有一个急转弯。
words.en: A curve is a smooth, gradually bending line, for example part of the edge of a circle.

words.ex: He threw the trash into the dustbin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: A dustbin is a container for waste, especially one that is kept outside a house or other building.

words.tr: n. 香味；香水；气息；察觉；
words.ex: The flower has a sweet scent.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花有甜美的香味。
words.en: A scent is a pleasant smell, especially one that is characteristic of a particular thing. It can also refer to the ability to detect smells or a clue or indication of something.

words.ex: He adds antifreeze to the car in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他在冬天给汽车加防冻液。
words.en: A substance added to a liquid to lower its freezing point, used especially in the radiator of a motor vehicle.

words.tr: n. 升温； v. （使）变暖；“warm”的现在分词；
words.ex: The warming of the planet is causing ice to melt.
words.ex_cn: 地球的升温正在导致冰层融化。
words.en: The process of becoming warmer; a rise in temperature.

words.ex: He uses a toaster to make toast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上用烤面包机烤面包。
words.en: A toaster is an electric device for making toast by heating slices of bread on both sides.

words.ex: He poured milk from a jug.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个水壶里倒牛奶。
words.en: A jug is a container used for holding and pouring liquids. It typically has a handle and a spout for easy pouring.

words.ex: The sponge lives in the ocean and filters water for food.
words.ex_cn: 这种海绵动物生活在海洋中，通过过滤水来获取食物。
words.en: A sponge is a piece of a soft, light, porous substance originally from the skeletons of marine creatures, used for washing, cleaning, or padding. As a verb, it means to wipe, rub, or clean with a sponge or to absorb something.

words.ex: Students take breaks between classes.
words.ex_cn: 学生在课间休息。
words.en: To separate into parts as a result of a blow, shock, or strain; to interrupt or cause to cease.

words.tr:
n. 火；
v. 射击；开火；
words.ex: The fire burned brightly in the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 火在壁炉里熊熊燃烧。
words.en: Fire is the heat and light that comes out when something burns. It can also refer to the act of shooting a weapon or the dismissal of an employee from a job.

words.tr:
n. 果皮；
v. 去皮；剥落；
words.ex: The apple peel is rich in fiber.
words.ex_cn: 苹果皮富含纤维。
words.en: To remove the outer covering from something, especially a fruit or vegetable.

words.tr: n. 烹饪； adj. 烹调用的； v. 烹饪；“cook”的现在分词；
words.ex: Cooking is her favorite hobby.
words.ex_cn: 烹饪是她最喜欢的爱好。
words.en: The act of preparing food by heating it.

words.ex: She learned cookery from her grandmother.
words.ex_cn: 她向祖母学习烹调法。
words.en: Cookery is the activity or skill of preparing and cooking food.

words.ex: She turned on the cooker to boil water.
words.ex_cn: 她打开炉子烧水。
words.en: A cooker is a device or appliance used for cooking food.

words.ex: She put the food on a clean plate.
words.ex_cn: 她把食物放在一个干净的盘子里。
words.en: A flat dish, typically circular and made of china, from which food is eaten or served.

words.ex: She heated the food in the microwave.
words.ex_cn: 她把食物放在微波炉里加热。
words.en: A microwave is a type of oven that cooks or heats food very quickly by using electromagnetic waves rather than heat.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗好的衣物； v. 洗；洗涤；“wash”的现在分词；
words.ex: She put the washing into the machine.
words.ex_cn: 她把要洗的衣物放进洗衣机里。
words.en: The act of cleaning something using water and usually soap or detergent.

words.ex: She stored jam in a glass jar.
words.ex_cn: 她把果酱存放在一个玻璃罐里。
words.en: A jar is a glass or clay container with a wide opening at the top and a lid, used especially for storing food.

words.ex: She wears a white apron while cooking.
words.ex_cn: 她做饭时穿着一件白色围裙。
words.en: An apron is a piece of clothing that you wear over the front of your normal clothes and tie round your waist, especially when you are cooking, in order to prevent your clothes from getting dirty.

words.ex: He cut the bread with a knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用刀切面包。
words.en: A knife is a tool for cutting or a weapon, consisting of a flat piece of metal with a sharp edge on the end of a handle.

words.ex: He put the lid on the box.
words.ex_cn: 他把盖子盖在盒子上。
words.en: A lid is a cover for a container, or the movable cover of the eye, known as the eyelid.

words.ex: The lids of the jars are tight.
words.ex_cn: 罐子的盖子很紧。
words.en: Covers for containers or the upper and lower folds of skin that cover the eye when it is closed.

words.tr:
n. 烟；烟雾；
v. 抽烟；冒烟；
words.ex: The fire produced thick smoke.
words.ex_cn: 火灾产生了浓烟。
words.en: Smoke consists of gas and small bits of solid material that are sent into the air when something burns.

words.tr:
adj. 干的；
v. 变干；
words.ex: The cloth is dry after the sun.
words.ex_cn: 这块布在阳光下晒干了。
words.en: If something is dry, there is no water or moisture on it or in it.

words.ex: She put the cake in the oven.
words.ex_cn: 她把蛋糕放进烤箱里。
words.en: An oven is a device for cooking food, using dry heat.

words.ex: She poured tea from the pot.
words.ex_cn: 她从壶里倒出了茶。
words.en: A pot is a deep round container used for cooking.

words.ex: She put the ice cream in the freezer.
words.ex_cn: 她把冰淇淋放进冷冻柜里。
words.en: A freezer is a device that is used to store food at very low temperatures in order to preserve it.

words.ex: He looked at the menu and chose pasta.
words.ex_cn: 他看了菜单，选择了意大利面。
words.en: A menu is a list of the food that is available at a restaurant or café.

words.ex: He picked up a spoon to eat the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起一把勺子喝汤。
words.en: A spoon is an object used for eating, stirring, and serving food. It has a small shallow bowl on a handle.

words.tr:
adj. 洁净的；干净的；
v. 打扫；使干净；
words.ex: The kitchen is clean after she wiped the counters.
words.ex_cn: 她擦了台面后，厨房变得洁净了。
words.en: If something is clean, it is free from dirt, marks, or unwanted substances.

words.ex: This is the cleanest room in the house.
words.ex_cn: 这是房子里最洁净的房间。
words.en: Superlative form of clean, meaning most free from dirt, marks, or impurities.

words.ex: He threw away the old book.
words.ex_cn: 他扔掉了那本旧书。
words.en: To dispose of something that is no longer useful or wanted; to waste an opportunity or advantage.

words.tr: n. 比萨饼；披萨；意大利薄饼；
words.ex: I ate a pizza for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚餐吃了一块比萨饼。
words.en: A pizza is a flat, round piece of dough baked with tomato, cheese, and sometimes other ingredients on top.

words.ex: She boiled an egg for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她为早餐煮了一个蛋。
words.en: An egg is an oval object that is produced by a female bird and which contains a baby bird. Other animals such as reptiles and fish also lay eggs.

words.ex: He eats an apple every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个苹果。
words.en: A round fruit with firm, white flesh and a green, red, or yellow skin.

words.tr:
n. 橙子；橙色；
adj. 橙色的；
words.ex: I ate an orange for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 我早餐吃了一个橙子。
words.en: A round juicy citrus fruit with a tough bright reddish-yellow rind.

words.ex: He ate a piece of chocolate after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一块巧克力。
words.en: A food preparation in the form of a paste or solid block made from roasted and ground cacao seeds, typically sweetened.

words.ex: He eats a nut every morning for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一颗坚果当早餐。
words.en: A nut is a fruit consisting of a hard or tough shell around an edible kernel. It is also a metal block with a threaded hole that is used with a bolt to fasten things together. Informally, it can refer to someone who is crazy or eccentric.

words.ex: He put sugar in his tea.
words.ex_cn: 他把糖放进茶里。
words.en: A sweet substance that is used to make food and drinks sweet. It is usually in the form of white or brown crystals.

words.ex: He drinks tea every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝茶。
words.en: Tea is a drink made by pouring boiling water onto the dried leaves of the tea bush. It is popular in many countries and is often served hot with milk and sugar.

words.ex: Children like to eat snacks after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在放学后吃零食。
words.en: Snacks are small amounts of food that are eaten between meals.

words.ex: He ate a potato for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一个土豆。
words.en: A potato is a round vegetable that grows underground and has white flesh with a brown, red, or yellow skin.

words.ex: He ate a coconut for snack.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一个椰子当零食。
words.en: A coconut is the large brown seed of a tropical tree, which has a hard shell containing white flesh that you can eat and a clear liquid that you can drink.

words.tr:
n. 淀粉；淀粉浆
v. 给（布）上浆
words.ex: The potato contains a lot of starch.
words.ex_cn: 土豆含有大量淀粉。
words.en: A carbohydrate that is the chief form of stored energy in plants, especially in seeds and tubers. It is also used in cooking and as a stiffening agent in textiles.

words.ex: She baked a chocolate cake for her birthday.
words.ex_cn: 她为生日烤了一个巧克力蛋糕。
words.en: A cake is a sweet food made by baking a mixture of flour, eggs, sugar, and fat in an oven. Cakes may be large and cut into slices or small and intended for one person only.

words.ex: She baked three cakes for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对烤了三个蛋糕。
words.en: A cake is a sweet food made by baking a mixture of flour, eggs, sugar, and fat.

words.ex: She adds spices to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她给汤里加香料。
words.en: Spices are substances obtained from plants, which are used to flavor food or drink.

words.ex: She added a little salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她在汤里加了一点盐。
words.en: Salt is a white crystalline substance that is used for seasoning or preserving food. It is also used in various industrial processes.

words.ex: I ate a fresh salad for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我午餐吃了一份新鲜的色拉。
words.en: A salad is a mixture of raw vegetables such as lettuce, cucumber, and tomatoes, often served with a dressing.

words.tr: n. 色拉；凉拌生菜；“salad”的复数
words.ex: She eats salads every day for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 她每天午餐都吃沙拉。
words.en: A mixture of raw vegetables, typically served as a dish, either alone or combined with other foods.

words.ex: He is eating soup for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他正在吃汤当午餐。
words.en: Soup is a liquid food made by boiling meat, fish, or vegetables in water or stock.

words.ex: He ate grilled shrimp for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了烤虾。
words.en: A shrimp is a small shellfish with a long tail and many legs, which can be eaten as food.

words.ex: I ate chicken for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚餐吃了鸡肉。
words.en: A chicken is a bird that is kept on a farm for its eggs and meat.

words.ex: He eats a banana every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一根香蕉。
words.en: A banana is a long curved fruit with a yellow skin and soft, sweet, white flesh inside.

words.ex: He ate a cherry from the bowl.
words.ex_cn: 他从碗里吃了一颗樱桃。
words.en: A cherry is a small, round fruit that is typically bright or dark red. It is often eaten fresh or used in cooking and baking.

words.ex: She added a tomato to her salad.
words.ex_cn: 她往沙拉里加了一个西红柿。
words.en: A tomato is a soft, red fruit that is eaten raw or cooked as a vegetable.

words.tr: n. 海产食物（如海鱼、贝类等）；
words.ex: We ate fresh seafood at the seaside restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海边的餐厅吃了新鲜的海产食物。
words.en: Seafood refers to fish and shellfish from the sea that are eaten as food.

words.ex: He eats rice every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃米饭。
words.en: Rice is a cereal grain that is the most widely consumed staple food for a large part of the world's human population, especially in Asia.

words.ex: He eats a carrot every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃一根胡萝卜。
words.en: A carrot is a long, thin, orange-colored vegetable that grows underground.

words.ex: He eats a sandwich for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃三明治。
words.en: A sandwich consists of two slices of bread with a layer of food such as cheese or meat between them.

words.ex: Sugar is an ingredient in this cake.
words.ex_cn: 糖是这个蛋糕的一个成分。
words.en: An ingredient is one of the substances that are combined to make something, especially in cooking.

words.ex: He bought three drinks at the café.
words.ex_cn: 他在咖啡馆买了三杯饮料。
words.en: Drinks refer to liquids that can be consumed, typically including water, tea, coffee, and alcoholic beverages. As a verb, it means to take liquid into the mouth and swallow it.

words.ex: She squeezed a lemon into her water.
words.ex_cn: 她把一个柠檬挤进水里。
words.en: A lemon is a bright yellow fruit with very sour juice. Lemons grow on trees in warm countries.

words.ex: She added lettuce to her sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 她在三明治里加了莴苣。
words.en: Lettuce is a plant with large green leaves that is eaten in salads.

words.ex: He drinks beer after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝啤酒。
words.en: Beer is an alcoholic drink made from grain.

words.ex: He eats tuna for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃金枪鱼。
words.en: A tuna is a large fish that lives in warm seas and is caught for food.

words.ex: She eats carrots to get vitamin A.
words.ex_cn: 她吃胡萝卜来获取维生素A。
words.en: Vitamin A is a fat-soluble vitamin that is essential for maintaining healthy vision, skin, and immune function.

words.ex: Eating vegetables gives you good nutrition.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜能提供良好的营养。
words.en: The process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.

words.tr:
n. 水；
v. 给…浇水；给（某地）供水；
words.ex: She drinks water every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喝水。
words.en: Water is a clear thin liquid that has no colour or taste when it is pure. It falls from clouds as rain and enters rivers and seas. All animals and plants need water in order to live.

words.tr: phrase. 餐饮设施；提供饮食服务的场所或设备
words.ex: The hotel has good catering facilities for guests.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店为客人提供了良好的餐饮设施。
words.en: Catering facilities refer to the services and equipment provided for preparing and serving food and drinks, especially at events or in institutions.

words.ex: She buys organic vegetables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买有机蔬菜。
words.en: Relating to or derived from living matter; denoting or characterized by a harmonious relationship between the elements of a whole.

words.tr: phrase. 饮食模式；食物结构
words.ex: His food pattern includes rice, vegetables, and fish every day.
words.ex_cn: 他的饮食模式每天包括米饭、蔬菜和鱼。
words.en: The typical types of food consumed by a person or group.

words.ex: Italian cuisine is famous for pasta and pizza.
words.ex_cn: 意大利烹调风格以意大利面和披萨闻名。
words.en: A style or method of cooking, especially as characteristic of a particular country, region, or establishment.

words.tr:
n. 日常饮食；节食；
v. 节制饮食；
words.ex: His diet includes lots of vegetables and fruits.
words.ex_cn: 他的日常饮食包括大量蔬菜和水果。
words.en: The food and drink usually consumed by a person or group; a special course of food to which one restricts oneself, either to lose weight or for medical reasons.

words.tr: phrase. 饮食模式；进食规律
words.ex: He changed his eating pattern to lose weight.
words.ex_cn: 他改变了饮食习惯来减肥。
words.en: An eating pattern refers to the combination of foods and beverages a person consumes over time, which can influence their health and risk of chronic diseases.

words.tr: n. 外卖餐馆；外卖食物；
words.ex: We ordered dinner from the Chinese takeaway.
words.ex_cn: 我们从一家中餐外卖店点了晚餐。
words.en: A takeaway is a main point or piece of information that you learn from something such as a meeting, discussion, or document.

words.tr: adj. 加热了的；激烈的； v. 加热；“heat”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The heated water bubbled in the pot.
words.ex_cn: 加热过的水在锅里冒泡。
words.en: If a discussion or debate is heated, it involves a lot of strong and often angry feelings.

words.ex: The tip of the pencil broke off.
words.ex_cn: 铅笔的尖端断了。
words.en: The end of a pointed or projecting object; a sum of money given to someone as a reward for their services; to give someone a small amount of money as a reward for their services.

words.ex: The lake is covered with ice in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天湖面结满了冰。
words.en: Ice is frozen water. It is a solid state of water that occurs when water freezes at or below 0 degrees Celsius.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.tr: phrase. 免费的开胃菜；免费的入门装
words.ex: The restaurant offers a free starter to every guest.
words.ex_cn: 餐厅为每位客人提供免费的开胃菜。
words.en: A complimentary introductory item or service offered to attract new customers, typically without charge.

words.tr:
adj. 寒冷的；冰冷的；
n. 寒冷；
words.ex: The cold wind made me shiver.
words.ex_cn: 寒冷的风让我发抖。
words.en: Something that is cold has a low temperature, especially when compared to the temperature of the human body. It can also describe a lack of warmth in someone's behavior or a situation.

words.ex: We had a quick meal at noon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃了一顿简单的饭。
words.en: A meal is an occasion when people sit down to eat food, especially breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

words.tr: n. 一餐；一顿饭；“meal”的复数；
words.ex: We eat three meals a day.
words.ex_cn: 我们一天吃三餐。
words.en: A meal is an occasion when people sit down to eat food, especially breakfast, lunch, or dinner.
